Restoration changes the game more than expected - one curse or illness ends instantly.

GMs: Save Restoration for when a curse or illness is the only thing stopping the party from moving forward.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Druid's spellcasting punishes poor positioning - Multiattack and area spells exploit clustering.

DMs: Punish clustering by casting Thunderwave; its 15-foot cube and 44 HP will remind them why spacing matters.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Medusa's Touch Blade can end a fight with one hit - Fort save DC is 1d10+10.

Judges: Wait for a high roll on the 1d10+10 DC before swinging Medusa's Touch Blade to maximize its petrifying potential.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Morale isn't just a flavor rule - it triggers on a DC 15 WIS check when half the monsters fall.

GMs: When half the monsters fall, roll that DC 15 Wisdom check for morale or expect endless, tedious combat.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

War Magic enhances survival more often than players expect - Arcane Deflection grants +2 AC or +4 to saving.

DMs: Use Arcane Deflection to negate one big threat per encounter, not every minor inconvenience.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Mighty Deeds of Arms often surprise players with their impact - the Deed works if the attack hits and the Deed.

Judges: Remind players their Deed die must show 3+ for success; no extra rolls or saves needed.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Sleep affects more creatures than most expect - up to 3d6 HD for 1 hour at spell check 18-19.

Judges: Cast Sleep when facing a horde of low-HD creatures; a spell check of 18-19 can incapacitate 3d6 HD for an hour.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Charge Sea Hag a real price.

Pearl Of Power's true strength is often overlooked - it only works once per day and can't recover spells lost.

GMs: Watch for players burning spells too soon; remind them the Pearl of Power is best saved for pivotal, tide-turning moments.

Emerald Wanderer resists mundane attacks - immune to non-magical weapons that aren't silvered.

Judges: Remind them that if their weapons aren't magical or silvered, they're just wasting time against the Emerald Wanderer.
